verification_commands.command: python -m unittest discover -s tools/v6 -t tools/v6 -p test_*.py

verification_commands.result: PASS: 16 production-method host scenarios; no hardware claims.

concern_config_failure_never_reuses_stal.evidence: wifi_station.cc:381-385 — on esp_wifi_set_config error it logs CONNECT_CONFIG_FAILED and `continue`s the loop without calling esp_wifi_connect(), so no connect can be issued with the previous credential.

concern_sync_failures_bounded_no_abort.evidence: wifi_station.cc:387-392 — esp_wifi_connect error logs CONNECT_START_FAILED and advances; the finite queue is drained by a while loop (no recursion, no ESP_ERROR_CHECK), then the scan timer is armed with the current backoff.

concern_failed_scan_never_triggers_hidde.evidence: wifi_station.cc:239-250 HandleScanDone(false) clears the queue, esp_wifi_clear_ap_list(), logs SCAN_COMPLETION_FAILED and backs off; HandleScanResult is not reached. wifi_station.cc:479 gates it on `scan != nullptr && scan->status == 0`, so a missing event payload also fails closed.

concern_fallback_only_after_full_channel.evidence: wifi_station.cc:299-320 — the fallback sits after the `last_scan_used_saved_channels_` escalation branch, so it only runs on a successful scan that used all channels. StartScan sets last_scan_used_saved_channels_ per attempt (182-227) and clears it when it falls back to a full scan.

concern_visible_ap_priority_pin_bounds_a.evidence: Visible matches fill connect_queue_ from the RSSI-sorted scan and StartConnect consumes that queue first (275-296, 327). saved_network_policy.h:13 returns empty when pinned; :14-22 caps at 3, skips empty/over-32/over-64/NUL credentials instead of truncating, and de-duplicates by SSID. wifi_station.cc:309-315 marks them direct with channel 0 and no BSSID.

concern_direct_state_transitions.evidence: wifi_station.cc:386 sets reconnect_count_ = MAX_RECONNECT_COUNT for a direct entry, so wifi_station.cc:492 skips the upstream five retries of the same fallback entry on disconnect and advances; :512-536 clears the queue, zeroes reconnect_count_, restores use_saved_channels_scan_ and resets the scan interval on got-IP; :116-126 resets the same state on every Start().

concern_async_disconnect_and_stop_bounda.evidence: WifiStation::Stop (59-98) unregisters both event handler instances first, then stops and deletes the scan timer, then stops scan/disconnect/stop and only then sets the STOPPED bit — so no callback or timer can fire after stop. STA_DISCONNECTED (480-507) has a bounded path: retries, then queue, then backoff.
concern_async_disconnect_and_stop_bounda.observation: wifi_station.cc:493 calls esp_wifi_connect() in the disconnect-retry path without checking its return value. A synchronous failure there arms no timer and produces no further event, so the station can go quiet until the board's 60s deadline. This is pre-existing upstream behaviour and is bounded by the board layer, but it is asymmetric with the new StartConnect handling that the same increment added. Reported, not fixed.

evidence: Generated component vs overlay.json: 22 of 24 recorded files are byte-identical to the pinned upstream commit; the 2 files listed in `replacements` (include/wifi_station.h, wifi_station.cc) differ as intended; no unexpected differences.

`.component_hash` and `CHECKSUMS.json` are absent from the generated copy, which is what integration/v6/network/README.md states (registry checksums omitted because they describe the unmodified package). Checked, expected.
One extra file, `include/saved_network_policy.h`, is present by design (project-owned policy).
tools/v6/network_overlay.py fails closed: dependency inventory mismatch, anchor count != 1, and a missing/stale/modified local override all raise.

CMake really selects the override: E:/v6/s1/build/compile_commands.json compiles E://v6//s1//components//78__esp-wifi-connect//wifi_station.cc and out/v6-device-build-12.txt:11 says 'Using component placed at E://v6//s1//components//78__esp-wifi-connect for dependency 78/esp-wifi-connect', with :289 listing that path among the component paths.

artifact_contains_new_literals.note: Each appears exactly once in build/xiaozhi.bin, so the network patch and the audio probe are in the image, not only in the source tree.

evidence: m0_diagnostics.cc:82-95 — on record it disables wake, clears the rearm state, then calls EnableVoiceProcessing(true) BEFORE EnableAudioTesting(true), with a comment that EnableVoiceProcessing resets decoder queues and the live consumer is what permits RX during local playback.
m0_diagnostics.cc:96-104 — playback is bounded: it ends on IsPlaybackIdle() OR a 10s deadline, and logs LOCAL_REFERENCE_PROBE_END drained=<bool>, so drained=0 is observable rather than silent.

m0_diagnostics.cc:105-110 — on a not-drained end it calls ResetDecoder(), disables voice processing and re-enables wake detection; AFE output packets are discarded locally in a bounded drain of up to 8 per loop iteration (119-122), never handed to a protocol.

m0_diagnostics.cc:135 — the loop yields with vTaskDelay(100ms), so the 8-per-iteration drain is about 80 packets/s, comfortably above an AFE packet rate of about 17/s at 60ms frames; no backpressure expected.
concern_audio_playback_consumer_local_dr.observation: m0_diagnostics.cc:120-126 — the HEALTH format string ends with `vad_observable=%d` but the last argument is `test == LocalTest::Playback`. The field therefore reports whether the local playback state is active, not VAD observability. This is a mislabel in a diagnostic that this project has already relied on for judgements; I decoded it as a playback flag in my own analysis and am reporting it for Codex to rename rather than changing the tool myself.

no_p0_p1.verdict: No P0/P1, no credential leakage in the new logs (they carry counts and error codes only), serial not opened by anyone else, and the frozen artifact matches the archive.

findings.summary: disconnect-retry calls esp_wifi_connect() without checking the return value; no timer is armed on synchronous failure
findings.repro: code reading; forcing it on hardware needs a driver-state fault
findings.impact: station can stall until the board 60s deadline; bounded, but asymmetric with the new StartConnect path

findings.summary: HEALTH's final field is printed as vad_observable= but carries `test == LocalTest::Playback`
findings.repro: read the format string against the argument list; during playback the field reads 1
findings.impact: evidence-interpretation hazard, not a functional defect
